quarterly_data.signal: Intel Foundry and ASML (SPIE Photomask / EUV conference): High NA EUV continues to be used in high-volume manufacturing at Intel Foundry, with more than one million wafers processed to date across early tool certification and testing, R&D and volume production on select layers for a subset of Core Ultra Series 3 (Panther Lake) processors; overlay, throughput and availability are meeting Intel Foundry's expectations. Products made on Intel 18A with High NA on select layers deliver performance that meets or exceeds comparable layers patterned with the NXE platform (0.33 NA EUV). Customers can use High NA with today's 6-inch masks by floor-planning or via Intel Foundry's stitching and PDK solutions; Intel Foundry EVP Naga Chandrasekaran said the near-term focus is High NA on 6-inch masks with or without stitching and the transition to 6x12-inch masks.
quarterly_data.figure: more than one million wafers processed on High NA EUV to date
